publish.//: Self-contained publish output used as the source for per-shard test runs. -c Debug matches the configuration used by the build target so coverage line counts (lines-valid) align with the rest of the test suite. ErrorOnDuplicatePublishOutputFiles is relaxed because the example ProjectReference glob causes content-file collisions (appsettings.json, pyproject.toml) when flattened into a single output dir.

test.//: Runs only affected example projects via scripts/run-tests.sh. Each example is sharded into its own copy of the publish output and run in parallel — coverage XMLs land in TestResults/{Name}/. Publish is an upstream dependency so the shard source is always up-to-date.

test:all.//: Runs every discovered example (--run-all flag). Identical output structure to test — each example gets TestResults/{Name}/coverage.cobertura.xml.

run:all.//: Alias for test:all. Runs every discovered example end-to-end and writes per-example coverage XMLs to TestResults/{Name}/. Useful when you think of the harness as 'running the examples' rather than 'testing them'.

test:discovery.//: Run only test discovery tests (smoke check for example project wiring). Uses the in-tree build output (no shard) — the discovery test doesn't exercise any example.
